name: Skin Cancer CNN Classifier
desc: A convolutional neural network designed to differentiate between benign and malignant skin lesions. Trained on a set of 10,000 images. Built using PyTorch and analyzed using Matplotlib. Boasts better than a 90% testing accuracy after 10 epochs of training.

name: NCDIT Procurement Tracker
desc: A full-stack web application built in collaboration with the North Carolina Department of IT. Designed to facilitate the complex IT procurement process by providing educational content, contact information, and a visual (similar to that of a pizza tracker) that displays an Agency's current step along the process. Built using Ruby on Rails, Rest API, a MySQL database, and containerized using Docker.

name: Intelligent API Scheduler
desc: An asynchronous API scheduling service built with FastAPI and Python. The system manages API requests through a priority queue, token-bucket rate limiting, exponential-backoff retry policies, persistent job tracking, and a real-time WebSocket dashboard.

name: Stock Visualizer
desc: A live WebSocket-based stock dashboard displaying updates across many symbols (AAPL, NVDA, etc). Any chart can display candles in any 1 of 7 intervals to get the full daily trading picture. Uses Alpaca for real market data, buckets all trades into intervals, handles network jitters/lag, and broadcasts updates to the dashboard.
